description_zh: 一辆公交车（ego）因前方排队停车，越过双黄线进入对向车道企图超车，并排时右侧车身擦碰原车道静止Waymo车辆左后侧。选择公交车为ego，其主动越线超车具测试价值。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling north ... and came to a stop in a queue of traffic.
a bus traveling directly behind the Waymo AV attempted to maneuver around the stopped Waymo AV by crossing the double yellow center line, entering the opposing lane of travel.
As the bus proceeded alongside the stationary Waymo AV, the passenger side of the bus made contact with the rear driver side of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 公交车是唯一主动移动且做出越线超车危险行为的车辆，Waymo AV静止无测试价值，故选公交车为ego；NPC静止在前方原车道，ego变道至对向车道后二者并排接触，用stopped_ahead表达前方静止车辆，adjacent right表达并排关系。
